lifecycle: At 390px the shared width command writes only the mobile breakpoint; at 1366px it writes only desktop.
Shared width and background-color controls update both selected Canvas nodes and expose responsive.set route metadata.
Invalid width is rejected and blocks Save and Publish without changing the saved model.
Valid width is saved to both Page Model nodes as a draft.
Public CSS stays unchanged after draft Save.
Explicit Publish updates both selected elements to 120px and the edited background color on the public page.
